summary.name: Ancient Greek Vase Painting. Category: Printmaking and Craft Materials; provenance extracted from the 2026-10-12 sync.
summary.visualIdentity: Terracotta vessel with dark figure silhouettes, meander and tongue bands, and a continuous frieze around its curved surface. Pale #F3DFC0 incised lines. No historical technique is claimed.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: objects whose story wraps around them, such as painted vessel friezes. Inferred: single-object explainers in video or interactive HTML. Audience, duration and aspect ratio are unspecified.
summary.limitations: A flat SVG unroll loses curvature, so a 3D lathe mesh is needed. Toon shading is excluded. Motion-043 would stop the vessel rotation the style specifies. Soft shadows do not establish photorealism.
summary.palette: Authored suggestions, not approved colors: background #100D09 (scene_dependent), foreground #F3DFC0, vessel #BA642F. Poster shows a dark brown-black scene; terracotta is never the background. Two-color contrast is 14.884, not a composited check.
summary.motionAndInteraction: GSAP rotates the vessel about 90° in a 3 s preview, continuing through the full video, while a mask reveals figures in register order. Motion-043 is an optional screened orbit. Interactive orbit should use motion-021 or motion-010.
summary.audio: Unspecified: none supplied or mandated. Inferred suggestion: restrained ambience or silence, with at most one soft accent as an orbit settles. Previews stay silent. Avoid beat-sync claims without measured data.
summary.assetRequirements: No painted layers, photos, fonts or exact copy were supplied; figures must be authored as Canvas 2D paths. Texture about 4096 px wide, seamless around the vessel. Subject, duration and output are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Optional secondary style-043 (Painted story figures) for figure work only; it must not import its palette or replace the background. Motion-043 fits only if a fixed vessel with camera orbit is acceptable.
summary.productionApproach: Three.js renders the vessel and Canvas 2D paints its texture; GSAP paused timeline owns rotation. HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion only if its fallback condition is verified and recorded.
